hypothesis: Within-root centered candidate features and realized return residuals transfer corrective action gaps without transferring unrelated state-value offsets; this improves complete navigation beyond ordinary absolute episodic residuals and fixed8 MPPI.
fit: All legal nonterminal actions of the existing non-paused 35-root catalogue, even numeric cases only. Odd numeric cases are heldout diagnostics. No new continuation labels.
representation: Frozen 256-dimensional candidate GRU features. Relative arm subtracts the safe candidate feature mean; absolute arm does not. All queries use the same CV successor windows used during deployment, not actual future states.
target: Absolute: fixed-world deployment continuation return minus original candidate Q. Relative: subtract the root mean from that residual. These are realized-world labels, not exact conditional expected Q.

retrieval.radius: 95th percentile of fitting-only leave-one-whole-case-out eighth-neighbor distance, separately for each representation

consumer: Add residual only to nonterminal candidate Q before the unchanged risk/mask/tie rule. Every arm other than nominal has the identical fixed8 MPPI intervention; only its nominal action ranking is changed by the memory arms. No network weight change.

development.scope: Previously used development cases, not independent confirmation; entirely disjoint from fitting catalogue cases.

go: No lower success count or greater contact/collision than ANY control; at least two additional successes versus every control OR at least 5% lower paired-both-success time versus the strongest control; relative correction must change at least one actual executed decision; mean decision time below 250ms. Confirmation additionally requires a positive case-bootstrap SR interval or a paired-time upper interval below zero, and a defensible independent mechanism beyond NEC/advantage centering/ranking.
kill: Failure of any frozen development condition, ordinary absolute correction absorbs the benefit, or primary-source review fully covers the actual capability. No sweep, no parameter rescue; preserve all data.
fairness: Identical legal observations, native80 actions, 50s/dt0.25, reward, all-human safety mask, 0.2 margin, 0.8 risk, 0.3 smoothing. Same memory rows/dimension/neighbors/kernel and no method-specific tuning. Both representations queried for both memory arms for comparable compute. No 4090 use, no RL training.
novelty_status: UNVERIFIED. Local memory, advantage centering and action ranking are established ingredients; an outcome improvement alone is not a paper PASS.
